filters.name: Move selected faces to another layer
filters.shortDescription: Move or duplicate the selected faces into a new mesh layer.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Selected faces are moved (or duplicated) in a new layer. Warning! per-vertex and per-face user defined attributes will not be transferred.

parameters.label: Delete original selection
parameters.help: Deletes the original selected faces, thus splitting the mesh among layers. If false, the selected faces are duplicated in the new layer.

filters.name: Move selected vertices to another layer
filters.shortDescription: Move or duplicate the selected vertices into a new mesh layer.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Selected vertices are moved (or duplicated) in a new layer. Warning! per-vertex user defined attributes will not be transferred.

parameters.label: Delete original selection
parameters.help: Deletes the original selected vertices, thus splitting the mesh among layers. If false, the selected vertices are duplicated in the new layer.

filters.name: Split in Connected Components
filters.shortDescription: Split the current layer into one layer per connected component.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Split current layer into many layers, one for each connected component.

parameters.label: Delete source mesh
parameters.help: Deletes the source mesh after all the connected component meshes are generated.

filters.name: Duplicate Current layer
filters.shortDescription: Create a new layer containing the same model as the current one.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Create a new layer containing the same model as the current one.

filters.name: Delete Current Mesh
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: The current mesh layer is deleted.

filters.name: Delete all non visible Mesh Layers
filters.shortDescription: Delete all non-visible mesh layers in the document.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: All the non visible mesh layers are deleted.

filters.name: Flatten Visible Layers
filters.shortDescription: Flatten all or only the visible layers into a single new mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown:
Flatten all or only the visible layers into a single new mesh.
Transformations are preserved. Existing layers can be optionally deleted.

parameters.label: Merge Only Visible Layers
parameters.help: If true, flatten only visible layers, otherwise all layers are used.

parameters.label: Delete Layers
parameters.help: Delete all the layers used as source in flattening. If all layers are visible only a single layer will remain after the invocation of this filter.

parameters.label: Merge duplicate vertices
parameters.help: Merge the vertices that are duplicated among different layers. Very useful when the layers are spliced portions of a single big mesh.

parameters.label: Keep unreferenced vertices
parameters.help: Do not discard unreferenced vertices from source layers. Necessary for point-cloud layers.

filters.name: Rename Current Mesh
filters.shortDescription: Explicitly change the label shown for the current mesh.
filters.longDescriptionMarkdown: Explicitly change the label shown for a given mesh.
